children: The South African rand was steady in early trade on Wednesday after recovering some losses from the previous two sessions, supported by gold prices returning above the $4,300-per-ounce level.
At 0820 GMT the rand traded at 16.26 against the dollar
, little changed from its previous close.
The firmer bullion price has improved sentiment towards the rand, given the importance of precious-metal exports to the local economy.
Oil prices, which had added pressure to the rand, fell on Wednesday after an unexpectedly large increase in U.S. crude inventories ended a two-day rally.

"The local currency is currently at 16.23 rand to the dollar, however, we could still see some short-term volatility ahead of the FOMC later today," said Andre Cilliers, Currency Strategist at TreasuryONE.
Market participants are looking ahead to the U.S. Federal Reserve's policy decision, with a rate hike largely priced in.
Domestic investors will focus on July retail sales data, due at around 1100 GMT. Economists polled by Reuters expect annual growth to rise by 0.9%.
On the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, the Top-40 index
South Africa's benchmark 2035 government bond (ZAR2035=) was firmer in early deals, with the yield down 3.5 basis points to 8.775%.
